name: ModelVariant801_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant801_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a ring of sprites spins up around the active slot, then each flies towards a jittered point on the opposing slot trailing a fading Gouraud ribbon and bursts into animated sparks on arrival while the ambient light dims and recovers); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, seeds the ring, targets and sparks and packs two texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 4 once when the first sprite arrives, 1 once when the last one does, 2 once the last burst has faded and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; only the USA and Japanese discs build this header. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
